title: pandas: sort_values
source:
import pandas as pd

plots = pd.read_csv("farm.csv").head(8)
ranked = plots.sort_values("yield_kg", ascending=False)
plots.sort_values("rainfall_mm", inplace=True)
back = plots.sort_index()

steps.narration: pd.read_csv("farm.csv").head(8) made a new DataFrame (8 rows × 6 columns): plots now refers to it.
Sorted the rows of plots by yield_kg, largest first: ranked is a new DataFrame with the same 8 rows in a new order.
Sorted the rows of plots by rainfall_mm, smallest first, in place: the same DataFrame, its rows in a new order.
Sorted the rows of plots by their index labels: back is a new DataFrame with the same 8 rows in a new order.
